_comment: Company-specific definitions generalized after redaction. Committed on purpose: these are the substitutions that make one business's agent read as a template. Longest key wins, same as the local map.
AI-driven solutions and AI agents. Sold: the software and automation offer. Sold to operators who suspect software should be handling work they still do by hand. The conversation is about leverage: what repetitive work is eating the team's week.
direct mail automation. Sold to operator: the done-with-you service offer. Sold to operators who already believe in the channel but are bottlenecked executing it. The conversation is about throughput and consistency.
`Website` — Brand A one-time website/SEO: `Brand A Project` — Brand A one-time project
AI SEO or Website (context decides retai: Brand A Retainer or Brand A Project (context decides)
A downsell from direct mail to website a: A downsell from Brand B to Brand A
ICP for both: real estate wholesalers an: ICP for both: owner-operators in your niche.
Real estate wholesalers and investors do: Owner-operators in your niche doing real volume.
route automation/agent conversations to: route automation conversations to the consult and project conversations to the project call
said yes to the inherited-house opener: said yes to the campaign opener
(AI/SEO/web/agents/automation/custom; ca: (all Brand A lines; calendar routing brand-a-project-call for projects, brand-a-consult for automation, 30min fallback)

Brand B: are they mailing today, what ma:
Brand B: are they doing the thing today, at what volume, and is demand actually the
constraint or is it capacity. Critical: a yes to the campaign opener often means interest
in the bait, not in the service. Clarify what they actually want before you ever offer
brand-b-consult.
never offer a booking link merely becaus: never offer a booking link merely because they said yes to the campaign opener — that often reflects interest in the bait, not the service; first clarify what they actually want and understand their volume and capacity, and only offer brand-b-consult after genuine interest.

In: doing the work now, or actively building to. Has a market. Has capacity to handle leads.
Out: tire-kickers, unrelated businesses, people asking for something you do not sell, and
end customers who mistook the campaign for a consumer offer.
